title: Transparent Sulfur Cube Outer
description: Juste make the sulfur cube outer transparent !
body:
This pack removes the outer texture of the sulfur cube, so when it is a block in the sulfur cube, il looks like tha is just a vanilla block without thinking this is a sulfur cube.
